head: working-tree
subject: Automatic Channelz counters for high-level gRPC channels
change: grpc.Channel.Options and grpc.SharedChannelOptions gain an allocation-free observer. Channel counts one logical unary call across retries and one terminal event per streaming/duplex stream; SharedChannel counts each sender unary call and each duplex stream. SharedChannel child transport channels explicitly drop the observer so a call is never counted twice. The internal Health Watch transport also drops the observer. Streaming completion reuses stream/completion.Observer, which now carries an optional call observer alongside the existing policy hook.
notes: The new regressions drive two unary calls (OK then NOT_FOUND) and one OK duplex stream through both a high-level Channel and a SharedChannel, then assert started=3, succeeded=2, failed=1 from a registry-backed Channelz channel. Streaming terminal classification treats an OK terminal status as success; resets, cancellation, non-OK terminals and transport failures increment calls_failed. The observer remains opt-in, so channels without one allocate no completion observer beyond the existing policy requirement.
